name: workflow-toolkit
description: Universal Claude Code workflow skills + reliability enforcement: anti-bloat guard on instruction files, per-turn hard-rule re-injection, independent verifier subagent, plus project bootstrap, machine bootstrap, project hygiene audit (2-layer: deterministic linter + judgement agent), skill usage audit (adoption, trigger fidelity, dead-skill triage on session transcripts), session retro, design system lookup, browser verification, claude.ai Artifact prototyping (CSP transform, base64-safe embed, Figma asset extraction), pre-deploy verification, coding principles, second-opinion advisor, structured divergent ideation (isolated frames → adversarial critic → deepen), handoff, memory discipline, web research, Linear ticket drafts, monthly inspiration sweep (snapshot-diff over Claude Cookbook + Claude Code changelog), held-out validation gate (temporal split of real skill invocations). Works across any project type, model-switch gate, and a hard spend-ceiling gate. Both cost gates read session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl) as their primary data source via an incremental byte-offset ledger — measured 2026-09-01, the statusline dump they relied on before was never written in the desktop interface, so both gates had been blind since day one. The statusline dump stays as an optional, harder signal when it exists (real 5h/7d percentages) and feeds a calibration log. Spend gate blocks the prompt at a daily weighted-token threshold (p90 of 18 measured working days) and on any new paid-credit spend past an acknowledged baseline; model gate asks for confirmation before switching to Fable 5 on an already-expensive day.
